prompt: Polish the Nigel Strutt NPC page for table readability. The page is at wiki/entities/npc/nigel-strutt.md. Preserve all facts, wikilinks, frontmatter, and embeds. The DM should be able to use this at the table without decoding agent prose.

assertions.text: All facts from the original page are preserved — nothing material added, nothing lost.
Wikilinks remain intact and resolve to the same targets.
The portrait includes a drawable face or body — not just role/job description.
No lines that fail the removal test — every line changes a DM choice, ruling, or improv handle.
No AI tell phrases: 'tapestry of', 'nestled between', 'a sense of', 'it's worth noting', 'the air is thick with'.
